changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE administration.trusted_devices ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, id_user bigint NOT NULL, token_hash varchar(64) NOT NULL, label varchar(100) NOT NULL, last_used_on timestamp NOT NULL, expires_on timestamp NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT trusted_devices_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT trusted_devices_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT trusted_devices_token_hash_key UNIQUE (token_hash), CONSTRAINT fk_users_on_trusted_devices FOREIGN KEY (id_user) REFERENCES administration.users (id) ); CREATE INDEX idx_trusted_devices_on_id_user ON administration.trusted_devices (id_user);
